title: Desktop Support Engineer 1
description:
Role & responsibilities: We are looking for a Desktop Support Engineer L1 to provide first-level technical support to end users and ensure smooth functioning of desktops, laptops, applications, and basic network connectivity. The candidate should have good communication skills and hands-on experience with IT support tools and troubleshooting. 
 Key Responsibilities: Provide L1 technical support to users through phone, email, ticketing tools, and in-person support. Log, track, update, and resolve incidents and service requests using the IT ticketing tool . Troubleshoot issues related to desktops, laptops, printers, peripherals, and basic network connectivity . Perform basic administration and troubleshooting of Active Directory , including user accounts, password resets, and access-related issues. Provide basic support for Microsoft Office 365 applications. Perform basic SCCM activities such as software deployment, system inventory, and troubleshooting. Support and troubleshoot BitLocker encryption and related issues. Diagnose and resolve basic hardware issues , including desktops, laptops, keyboards, mice, monitors, and other peripherals. Troubleshoot basic network issues , including LAN connectivity, Wi-Fi, IP configuration, and related connectivity problems. Escalate unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate L2/L3 teams while maintaining proper ticket documentation. Maintain accurate records of incidents, resolutions, and user interactions. Follow standard IT support processes, SLAs, and escalation procedures. 
 Required Skills: 
 1.52.5 years of experience in Desktop Support / IT Helpdesk / Service Desk. Good English communication skills , both written and verbal. Hands-on experience with IT ticketing tools . Basic knowledge of Active Directory . Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 . Basic knowledge of SCCM . Working knowledge of BitLocker encryption . Basic hardware troubleshooting skills. Basic network troubleshooting skills. Good problem-solving and customer-service skills. Preferred Profile: 
 ITIL awareness or certification will be an advantage. Experience working in a corporate IT support or service desk environment. Ability to work independently and follow defined processes and SLAs. Strong customer orientation and willingness to learn.

Key Skills: Active Directory,O365 Admin,SCCM,Bitlocker,IT Infrastructure Management,Desktop,Infrastructure management,Administration
